name: Fire Tar
summary: Across the eastern Barrens, Razormane spellcasters carry Fire Tar. Horde shamans use it to brew the Fire Sapta, which lets them commune with fire spirits.

sections.title: A Concoction of the Razormane
sections.body: Razormane geomancers, mystics, and thornweavers carry Fire Tar. The quilboar use the flame-tuned substance in their harsh magic and rituals. Shamanic instructors prize it as a worldly reagent that helps mortal senses reach the raw fury of the elements.

sections.title: The Path to the Fire Totem
sections.body: Young orc and troll shamans travel to Telf Joolam, high among Durotar's crags, to forge their fire totems. Telf asks them for a reagent pouch taken from Burning Blade cultists and Fire Tar gathered from the Razormane. He brews the two ingredients into a fire sapta. Drinking it lets a shaman perceive the fire spirits waiting atop the nearby peaks.

faq.q: What is Fire Tar used for?
aliases: why do i need fire tar
faq.answer: Shamans bring Fire Tar to Telf Joolam in Durotar, where he brews it with reagents from the Burning Blade into a Fire Sapta. The brew lets a shaman see and commune with fire spirits to earn a fire totem.
Spellcasting Razormane quilboar carry Fire Tar in the eastern Barrens. These include Razormane Geomancers, Mystics, Thornweavers, and Water Seekers.

faq.q: Why do shamans need ingredients tied to hostile spellcasters?
faq.answer: Saptas need physical components saturated with the matching element. Razormane casters and Burning Blade warlocks channel heat and destructive flame, so their everyday materials carry the fiery essence needed to awaken a shaman's elemental sight.

faq.q: Where does Telf Joolam brew the Fire Sapta?
faq.answer: Telf Joolam brews the Fire Sapta on a high cliff overlooking Durotar's crags, near the path between Razor Hill and the Barrens. He teaches initiates to balance flame's destructive and creative nature.

angles.text: As a shaman, gathering Fire Tar is an essential rite of passage. You seek elemental resonance in the wider world, then use it to brew the Fire Sapta and earn your Fire Totem.
As a member of the Horde, you cross the Southfury River from Durotar into the Barrens to gather Fire Tar. There you face the aggressive Razormane tribes.
